spanish: Si en su soledad viene, en su soledad saldrá; si dueño de mujer él, y saldrá su mujer con él.

findings.issue: «soledad» names solitude/loneliness. H1610 with בְּ and a 3ms suffix is the noun body/back/person (his body/self), which those tokens do not license as solitude.

notes: Other tokens keep if, come/go out, owner of a woman, he, his woman, and with him, with person and number intact.
